name: MixRoute
overview: MixRoute advertises $5 starting credit on popular models with no card; topping up unlocks the wider catalogue. The grant is a finite starting credit, not a daily allowance, and eligible model IDs and expiry should be confirmed in the console. No signup, inference or billing was tested.
free_access: No card required according to operator
Eligible models and expiry need confirmation
notes: Base URL https://api.mixroute.ai/v1. Confirm the selected model is eligible for the starting credit.
